additionalCheckedSources.terms: CC BY, credit Menard et al2021, DOI10.3389/fpsyg.2021.620349; contextual diary of COVID lockdown
additionalCheckedSources.finding: Recovery experiences and social context modify later stress/worry; not a universal decay curve.

additionalCheckedSources.disposition: Excluded from commercial calibration; no coefficients extracted.

gaps.bestAvailableEstimate: Extracted 28-minute affect inertia and between-person SD provide a short-term calibration range; they cannot identify day-scale stress decay. Retain those two day-scale constants as registered tunables until a compatible multi-day experiment is licensed and sampled.
gaps.basis: Persistent causes, renewed stress, recollection and acute affect are separate processes.

gaps.bestAvailableEstimate: No study identifies arbitrary game utility weights. Source findings support dependence on stress, context and individual traits; owner tuning and observable choices remain required.

adoption: Use observations to check aggregate temporal correlations at matching sampling intervals. No random stress or emotion assignments; no probability of decay per day.
